items.title: Luke Kennard (left knee tendinopathy) is questionable for the Suns’ season opener tomorrow, while Mark Williams (left shoulder surgery) is obviously out. For the Blazers, Deni Avdija (right ankle soreness) is questionable and Shaedon Sharpe (right meniscus surgery) is out
items.author: Gerald Bourguet
